items.scene: 你在车站售票窗口问

answers.en: Do you have round-trip tickets?
answers.note: round-trip 是美式“往返”，英式说 return。

answers.en: Can I book a round trip?
Is it cheaper to buy round trip?

items.scene: 你在车站售票窗口问

answers.en: Is there first class?
Do you have first-class seats?
How much more is first class?

items.scene: 你在车站售票窗口问

answers.en: Is there business class?
answers.note: 商务座直译 business class，中国高铁通用。

answers.en: Can I book business class?
What's the difference between first and business class?
answers.note: 问一等座和商务座差在哪。
answers.zh: 一等座和商务座有什么区别？

items.scene: 你在车站售票窗口问

answers.en: Are there standing tickets?
Can I buy a standing ticket?
Is standing allowed on this train?
answers.note: 问这趟车允不允许站票。

items.scene: 你在车站售票窗口问

answers.en: Are there any overnight trains?
Is there a night train?
What's the latest train?

items.scene: 你在售票窗口问

answers.en: Where do I transfer?
Which station do I change at?
answers.note: change at 是英式也常用的换乘说法。

answers.en: Is the transfer at Nanjing?

items.scene: 你在换乘通道口问工作人员

answers.en: How much time do I need for the transfer?
Is forty minutes enough to transfer?
answers.note: 拿具体时间确认够不够。

answers.en: How long does the transfer take?

items.scene: 你在售票窗口问

answers.en: How do I book a connecting ticket?
Can I buy both legs together?
answers.note: leg 指一段行程，both legs 是两段一起买。

answers.en: Do I have to buy two separate tickets?

items.scene: 你在售票窗口问

answers.en: Can I choose my seat?
Can I pick a seat when I book?
Is seat selection available?
answers.note: 更正式，问有没有选座服务。

items.scene: 你在安检口问工作人员

answers.en: Can I bring alcohol on the train?
Is there a limit on alcohol?
Do they check bags for drinks?

items.scene: 车晚点了，你在服务台问

answers.en: Can I get a delay certificate?
answers.note: delay certificate 是晚点证明，报销或请假常用。

answers.en: I need proof that the train was late.
answers.note: proof 是证明，说清楚用途。

answers.en: Could you write a note for my boss?
answers.note: 口语说法，请对方开个给单位看的说明。
answers.zh: 能给我开个给单位看的说明吗？

items.scene: 你在车站自助售票机前问工作人员

answers.en: How do I use the ticket machine?
answers.note: ticket machine 是自助售票机。

answers.en: Does the machine take cash?
Can I buy a ticket here with my passport?
answers.note: 外国护照不一定能在自助机买，先问。

items.scene: 你在车站大厅找取票机

answers.en: Which machine do I use to print my ticket?
Which machine prints tickets?
Can I collect my ticket at any machine?
answers.note: 问是不是任意一台都能取。

items.scene: 你在检票口问工作人员

answers.en: How do I get in with an e-ticket?
Do I scan a QR code?
Where do I show my e-ticket?

items.scene: 你在车站外问路人

answers.en: Where's the entrance?
Which entrance do I use?
answers.note: 大站有多个入口，问走哪个。

answers.en: Is this the way in?
answers.note: 问这个方向是不是进站。

items.scene: 你在站台问工作人员

answers.en: How do I get to the transfer passage?
Where's the transfer walkway?
Do I follow the transfer signs?
answers.note: 问是不是跟着换乘标识走。

items.scene: 你在车站大厅问工作人员

answers.en: Is there a subway station here?
Does the subway connect to the station?
answers.note: 问地铁和火车站通不通。

answers.en: Where's the subway entrance?

items.scene: 你出站后问工作人员

answers.en: Where can I get a taxi?
Where's the taxi stand?
answers.note: taxi stand 是出租车候车点。

answers.en: Is there a taxi line?
answers.note: taxi line 是排队打车的队。

items.scene: 你出站后问工作人员

answers.en: Where do I meet my ride?
answers.note: ride 指网约车，meet my ride 是上车。

answers.en: Where's the rideshare pickup?
answers.note: rideshare pickup 是网约车上车点。

answers.en: Can the driver pick me up at the exit?
answers.note: 问司机能不能到出口接。

items.scene: 你开车来接人，问工作人员

answers.en: Where's the parking lot?
Is there parking at the station?
What's the parking rate?

items.scene: 你在候车厅问工作人员

answers.en: Is there a convenience store here?
Where's the nearest store?
Can I buy snacks in the station?

items.scene: 你在候车厅问工作人员

answers.en: Where can I eat in the station?
Are there restaurants here?
Is there a food court?

items.scene: 你有点不舒服，问工作人员

answers.en: Is there a pharmacy in the station?
Where can I buy medicine?
Is the pharmacy open?

items.scene: 你手机没电，在候车厅问工作人员

answers.en: Do you rent power banks?
answers.note: rent 是租，power bank 是充电宝。

answers.en: Where's the power bank rental?
answers.note: 问租充电宝的机器在哪儿。

answers.en: Can I return it at another station?

items.scene: 你拖着行李在车站大厅问

answers.en: Are there lockers here?
Can I rent a locker?
How much is a locker for a few hours?

items.scene: 你东西被偷了，在车站找人问

answers.en: Where's the station police office?
answers.note: station police office 是车站警务室。

answers.en: Can I find a police officer here?
answers.note: 问站里能不能找到警察。

answers.en: I need to report a theft.
answers.note: theft 是盗窃，报案用这个说法。

items.scene: 你在车站觉得头晕，问工作人员

answers.en: Where's the medical room?
Is there a first aid room?
answers.note: first aid room 是急救室。

answers.en: I need a doctor.

items.scene: 你和家人走散了，找服务台

answers.en: Can you make an announcement for me?
answers.note: make an announcement 是广播通知。

answers.en: Can you page someone?
I'm looking for my mother. Can you help?

items.scene: 你在车站到达口问工作人员

answers.en: I'm picking someone up. Where should I wait?
Where's the arrivals area?
Can I wait by the exit?

items.scene: 你在检票口问工作人员

answers.en: Can I meet someone on the platform?
Do I need a ticket to get to the platform?
Where do passengers come out?

items.scene: 你在站台上找车厢

answers.en: How do I find my car number?
Where's car 7?
Are the car numbers on the platform?
answers.note: 问站台上有没有车厢号标识。

items.scene: 你上卧铺车后问乘务员

answers.en: How do I exchange my ticket for a sleeper?
answers.note: 中国卧铺要换票，exchange 是换。

answers.en: Do I need to swap my ticket on board?
answers.note: swap 是换，问车上要不要换票。

answers.en: Where do I get the sleeper ticket?

items.scene: 你在卧铺车厢问乘务员

answers.en: Can I switch to a lower berth?
Is there a lower berth available?
Can I pay to move to the bottom bunk?
answers.note: bottom bunk 也是下铺，更口语。

items.scene: 你在卧铺车厢问乘务员

answers.en: Do you have a wake-up call?
Can you wake me before my stop?
Will someone wake me up?

items.scene: 你上车后问乘务员

answers.en: Will you tell me when my stop comes?
Could you give me a heads-up before my stop?
answers.note: give someone a heads-up 是提前打个招呼。
answers.zh: 到站前能提前跟我说一声吗？

answers.en: Does the train announce the stops?

items.scene: 你上车后问旁边乘客

answers.en: How do I fold down the tray table?
answers.note: tray table 是小桌板，fold down 是放下来。

answers.en: Where's the tray table?
Can I put my laptop on this?

items.scene: 你上车后问旁边乘客

answers.en: Can I recline my seat?
How do I lean the seat back?
Is this seat reclining?

items.zh: 广播听不清，能再说一遍吗？
items.scene: 你问旁边的乘客

answers.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that. What did they say?
answers.note: didn't catch that 是没听清，很自然。
answers.zh: 不好意思没听清，刚才说什么？

answers.en: Could you repeat the announcement?
answers.note: repeat the announcement 是重复广播内容。

answers.en: What was the gate change?
answers.note: 只听懂改站台，问具体改到几号。

items.scene: 你发现上错车，问乘务员

answers.en: I got on the wrong train. What do I do?
answers.note: got on the wrong train 是上错车。

answers.en: Can I get off at the next stop?
Will they let me switch trains?
answers.note: 问能不能换回正确的车。

items.scene: 你在候车厅看到停运通知

answers.en: The train is canceled. What are my options?
answers.note: options 是可选方案，问怎么安排。
answers.zh: 车停运了，我有哪些选择？

answers.en: Will they refund me?
answers.note: refund 是退款，问会不会退钱。

answers.en: Can you rebook me on another train?
